message.content:
Here’s a quick mix‑and‑match guide so you’ve got something for every mood—classic chills, modern dread, psychological twists, and even a few cult gems:

| Era / Subgenre | Movie (Year) | Why It Stands Out |
|-----------------|--------------|-------------------|
| **Classic Slasher** | *Halloween* (1978) – John Carpenter | The original “killer mask” movie; simple but effective terror. |
| | *Friday the 13th* (1980) – Sean S. Cunningham | Introduced Jason Voorhees & campy survival vibes. |
| **Psychological Horror** | *Psycho* (1960) – Alfred Hitchcock | Masterclass in suspense + iconic shower scene. |
| | *Black Swan* (2010) – Darren Aronofsky | Blurs reality/obsession with haunting visuals. |
| **Supernatural** | *Poltergeist* (1982) – Tobe Hooper | Family haunted by malevolent spirits; creepy doll scenes. |
| | *The Conjuring* (2013) – James Wan | Modern take on real‑life paranormal investigators. |
| **Found Footage** | *The Blair Witch Project* (1999) – Daniel Myrick & Eduardo Sánchez | Pioneered low‑budget realism; still unnerving. |
| | *Paranormal Activity* (2007) – Oren Peli | Simple home‑security camera setup turns terrifying. |
| **Modern Dread** | *Get Out* (2017) – Jordan Peele | Social satire meets genuine jump‑scares. |
| | *A Quiet Place* (2018) – John Krasinski | Silence as weapon; tense family drama. |
| | *Hereditary* (2018) – Ari Aster | Brutally emotional descent into inherited evil. |
| **Cult Classic** | *Evil Dead II* (1987) – Sam Raimi | Over-the-top gore mixed with dark humor. |
| | *It Follows* (2014) – David Robert Mitchell | Creepy curse delivered via relentless pursuit. |

### Quick Streaming Check (as of mid‑2026)
- **Netflix:** *Hereditary*, *It Follows*
- **Amazon Prime Video:** *The Conjuring*, *A Quiet Place*
- **Hulu:** *Get Out*, *Poltergeist*
- **Disney+:** *Frozen* (not horror), skip this one!
- **Shudder (subscription):** All the above plus many more niche horrors if you’re looking for deeper cuts.

Pick based on your preferred scare style—whether you want a nostalgic slash, an unsettling mind game, or a fresh twist on old tropes! Happy watching… if you dare.
